anti_join.description: NOT EXISTS subquery, planned as an anti join.

bitmap_heap_scan.description: Bitmap heap scan over a week of orders.

bitmap_lossy.description: Bitmap heap scan over most of the table with a tiny work_mem, so the bitmap becomes lossy and rows are rechecked.

bitmap_or.description: BitmapOr that combines two ranges on the same index.

cte_materialized.description: MATERIALIZED CTE scanned once: a CTE Scan plus the CTE subplan.

cte_multiple_scans.description: CTE referenced twice, so it is materialized once and read by two CTE Scan nodes.

cte_recursive.description: Recursive CTE: a Recursive Union over a WorkTable Scan.

delete_fk_trigger.description: DELETE on a referenced table; the foreign-key trigger scans the unindexed order_items.order_id for every deleted row.

disabled_seqscan.description: enable_seqscan = off on a table without indexes; PostgreSQL 18 marks the node as disabled, older versions add disable_cost to its estimate.

estimate_only.description: Plain EXPLAIN without ANALYZE: estimates only.

generic_plan.description: EXPLAIN (GENERIC_PLAN) of a parameterized query as it appears in application logs (PostgreSQL 16 and later).

group_aggregate.description: Sorted GROUP BY (group aggregate) with hash aggregation disabled.

hash_aggregate.description: GROUP BY on a low-cardinality column (hash aggregate).

hash_aggregate_spill.description: Hash aggregate that spills to disk because work_mem is tiny (PostgreSQL 13 and later).

hash_join.description: Hash join of every order with its customer; whole tables are needed, so no index helps.

hash_join_batches.description: Hash join whose hash table does not fit in work_mem and is split into batches on disk.

index_only_scan.description: Index-only scan on a freshly vacuumed table, with no heap fetches.

index_only_scan_heap_fetches.description: Index-only scan on a table whose visibility map is out of date, so most rows need a heap fetch.

index_scan_backward.description: ORDER BY ... DESC LIMIT served by scanning an index backwards.

index_scan_filter.description: Index range scan on created_at that discards most rows with a filter on status.

initplan.description: Uncorrelated scalar subquery evaluated once as an InitPlan.

insert_select_fk_checks.description: INSERT ... SELECT that fires a foreign-key check for every inserted row.

insert_wal.description: INSERT with the WAL option: WAL records, full-page images and bytes (PostgreSQL 13 and later).

jit_overhead.description: JIT compilation forced on a tiny query, so compiling takes far longer than executing.

lateral_join_top_n.description: LATERAL top-3 per customer; without an index on customer_id, every loop walks the created_at index backwards and discards most of the rows it reads.

merge_join.description: Merge join, forced by disabling hash and nested-loop joins.

misestimate_correlated_columns.description: city determines country, but the planner multiplies their selectivities and underestimates the row count 20x.

misestimate_stale_stats.description: Statistics predate 50,000 inserted 'active' rows, so the estimate is off by orders of magnitude.

nested_loop_cartesian.description: Missing join condition: every selected customer is paired with every book.

nested_loop_index.description: Nested loop with a primary key lookup on the inner side (the good case).

nested_loop_inner_seq_scan.description: Nested loop that scans all of order_items for every outer row because order_id has no index.

nested_loop_memoize.description: Nested loop with a Memoize cache in front of the inner index scan (PostgreSQL 14 and later).

never_executed.description: The outer side returns no rows, so the inner side of the nested loop is never executed.

parallel_aggregate.description: Partial aggregates in parallel workers, combined by a Finalize Aggregate.

parallel_gather_merge.description: Workers sort in parallel and a Gather Merge combines the sorted streams.

parallel_hash_join.description: Parallel hash join between orders and order_items.

parallel_seq_scan.description: Parallel sequential scan under a Gather node.

parallel_workers_not_launched.description: The plan asks for two workers but none can start because max_parallel_workers is 0.

partition_append_all.description: No partition key in the predicate, so an Append scans all twelve partitions.

partition_prune_plan_time.description: Only one partition is scanned because the constant range is pruned at plan time.

partition_prune_runtime.description: The partition key is compared with an InitPlan result, so pruning happens during execution and pruned partitions are never executed.

partition_prune_startup.description: Comparing with a date makes the predicate stable rather than immutable, so partitions are removed at executor startup.

semi_join.description: EXISTS subquery turned into a join: either a semi join or a join over de-duplicated subquery rows.

seq_scan_cast_on_column.description: The column is cast to text, so even an index on customer_id could not be used.

seq_scan_full_aggregate.description: Aggregate over a whole table; a sequential scan is the right plan.

seq_scan_function_on_column.description: date_trunc() on a timestamptz column is not immutable, so the fix is a range predicate rather than an expression index.

seq_scan_jsonb_containment.description: jsonb containment filter on every partition of a partitioned table; only a GIN index could help.

seq_scan_like_prefix.description: LIKE prefix search under a non-C collation; a btree index would need text_pattern_ops.

seq_scan_like_substring.description: Substring LIKE search; only a pg_trgm GIN index could help.

seq_scan_limit_early_stop.description: LIMIT stops the sequential scan after a few hundred rows.

seq_scan_low_selectivity.description: Filter that keeps about 70% of the rows, so a sequential scan is the right plan.

seq_scan_or_across_columns.description: OR across two unindexed columns; no single index serves the predicate.

seq_scan_selective.description: Sequential scan whose filter keeps 10 of 200,000 rows because customer_id has no index.

seq_scan_tiny_table.description: Filter on a 50-row table, where an index would not help.

serialize_memory.description: EXPLAIN with SERIALIZE and MEMORY: output serialization cost and planner memory (PostgreSQL 17 and later).

sort_external_merge.description: Sort that spills to disk because work_mem is tiny.

sort_incremental.description: Incremental sort on top of an index that provides the leading sort key (PostgreSQL 13 and later).

sort_top_n_heapsort.description: ORDER BY ... LIMIT on an unindexed column: a top-N heapsort over the whole table.

subplan_correlated.description: Correlated scalar subquery run once per outer row (SubPlan), each time scanning all of order_items.

subplan_hashed.description: NOT IN over a subquery, evaluated as a hashed SubPlan.

timing_off.description: EXPLAIN ANALYZE with TIMING OFF: actual rows and loops, but no per-node times.

update_by_pk.description: UPDATE of a primary key range (ModifyTable over an index scan).
